# Granite 4.0 1B

IBM · released 2025-10 · 1.63B params · apache-2.0

**score 33.7** ±2.7 · #396 of 462 · from 3 benchmark results across 1 source

Score within the [LMArena (text)](https://whatmodel.sh/?set=lmarena-text&score=set) comparison set only.

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

<pre>
source    test                      score  implies  date        weight
<a name="epoch-internal"></a>Epoch AI  <a href="https://epoch.ai/data/benchmark_data.zip#gpqa_diamond.csv">GPQA Diamond</a>              24.0%    25.6   2026-08-28   44% ▇▇▇▇▇
          <a href="https://epoch.ai/data/benchmark_data.zip#otis_mock_aime_2024_2025.csv">OTIS mock AIME 2024–2025</a>   0.8%    38.4   2026-08-30   43% ▇▇▇▇▇

prior     pull toward the middle             50.0                 3% ▇
          weighted average                 = 33.7
